Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — EdgeX is keen to move forward. Our procurement team has a couple of requirements before we can process invoices:

- PO: 78932 (attached)
- We prefer invoices to be issued into our AP portal (Coupa) as XML, but compliance requires a human-readable PDF copy to be emailed to ap@edgexsystems.com for invoices > EUR 25,000. Can Redwood send both the portal XML and an emailed PDF copy when that threshold is hit?
- We operate under reverse-charge for services in the EU. Please include our VAT number on the invoice and a line note: 'Reverse charge applies — customer VAT ID  EU-GB123456789'.
- For this first invoice we need split-billing: 60% on activation and 40% 30 days later. Will Redwood issue two linked invoices (same PO) or a single invoice with payment schedule?

Attached: PO_78932.pdf

Also attaching our VAT cert in a separate reply if needed. Can you confirm the invoice format and expected invoice dates?

Best,
Laura

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear requirements and the PO. Happy to confirm we can support your preferred flow with a couple of configuration notes:

1) Portal + emailed PDF copy: We can push the XML to Coupa (or SFTP) and send an emailed PDF copy automatically for invoices above a configurable threshold. We typically use a threshold flag (invoice_copy_threshold = EUR 25000) — we can set this on your account.

2) VAT / reverse charge: We will include the provided VAT ID and a reverse-charge note on the invoice line items. Please send the official VAT certificate so Billing can attach the evidence.

3) Split billing: We can either issue two invoices linked via a parent invoice ID (recommended) or one invoice with payment milestones. Billing prefers two invoices so AP can match each payment to a single invoice line. If you confirm 60/40, we'll create invoice S-78932-A (60%) and S-78932-B (40%) with the same PO number and a cross-reference.

Action items for EdgeX to confirm: VAT certificate (for attachment), final approval of 60/40 split, and whether you want first invoice due on receipt or Net 14.

If you confirm, I'll spin up the order in our billing system and loop in Billing to create the two linked invoices.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Thanks — need guidance so I can confirm with Laura today.

—Marissa

From: connor_obrien@redwood.com

Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: EdgeX PO 78932 — portal copy threshold & split invoicing

Marissa — that's all feasible. Implementation notes: 

- Billing system supports per-account thresholds. I'll set deliver_pdf_copy = true and pdf_copy_threshold = 25000 (EUR) for EdgeX. The XML push to Coupa will be the primary invoice payload; we'll include 'pdf_copy: true' in the webhook so AP gets the email copy.
- For split invoices we create two invoices with invoice numbers linked via parent_id = S-78932. We populate 'invoice_link' in the XML for Coupa so your AP team can match both to PO 78932.
- VAT handling: Billing can attach customer-supplied vat_certificate_EU-12345.pdf to both invoice records and add the line item note 'Reverse charge — customer VAT EU-GB123456789'. We also record the customer's VAT ID in the invoice header.
- Terms: suggest invoice A (60%) = Due on receipt or Net 14 per Laura; invoice B (40%) = Net 30. If they need both Net 30 we can do that but 'A on receipt' reduces our risk.

I'll make the config changes once Marissa confirms and Laura returns the VAT certificate.

Connor O'Brien
Billing Integrations Manager
Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com

- We'll set the account flags: deliver_pdf_copy = true; pdf_copy_threshold = 25000 EUR; xml_push_target = 'coupa:edgex-customer-id-431'.
